title: Invoice processing automation
content: Received invoices are uploaded to a secure location, after which their main fields are extracted and checked. Incomplete documents are routed for human validation before export to the accounting system.

title: Data pipeline quality checks
content: Each load checks the schema, mandatory values, duplicates and expected volumes. Blocking anomalies interrupt the flow, while minor discrepancies are logged with an owner and correction date.

title: Access to sensitive data
content: Access to sensitive data follows the principle of least privilege: each user receives only the permissions required for their work. Multi-factor authentication, periodic access reviews and access logging are mandatory.

title: Incident classification and handling
content: An incident is classified according to its business impact and the number of affected users. Critical incidents trigger immediate response, regular communication and root cause analysis with an action plan after service is restored.

title: Data retention and deletion
content: Each data category has a retention period, an owner and a deletion rule. Data reaching the end of its retention period is deleted or anonymised unless a documented business or regulatory obligation applies.

title: Deploying an AI model to production
content: Before production, the model is evaluated on representative cases, edge cases and quality criteria defined with the business. The version, test data, results and rollback conditions are retained to ensure traceability.

title: Power BI metric documentation
content: Each metric must specify its business definition, formula, granularity, source, refresh frequency and owner. Every change is validated with users and added to the KPI dictionary.

title: Customer onboarding checks
content: Onboarding collects the required identity information and supporting documents, then checks their consistency. Any compliance alert must be analysed, documented and approved before the customer record is activated.

title: Application change management
content: A production release describes the change, risks, tests performed and rollback plan. High-impact changes require formal approval and are avoided during critical business periods.

title: Personal data protection
content: The collection of personal data must serve an explicit purpose and be limited to information that is genuinely necessary. Data subjects are informed about its use, retention period and how to exercise their rights.

title: Data flow monitoring
content: Monitoring tracks processing status, duration, loaded volumes and encountered errors. An alert is sent when the flow fails, exceeds its usual duration or produces an inconsistent volume.

title: Customer master data quality
content: The customer master applies uniqueness, completeness and consistency rules to identifiers, contact details and statuses. Potential duplicates are matched using documented criteria before any merge.

title: Improving the reliability of a RAG assistant
content: A RAG assistant must cite the documents used, limit its answer to retrieved information and flag when sources are insufficient. Quality is measured using a reference question set, business review and monitoring of unsupported answers.

title: KPI validation and governance
content: A KPI is validated when its definition, source and calculation rules are shared by the relevant teams. A business owner arbitrates changes, and an automated check verifies data freshness and completeness.
